messages:
Priya S: LumaBank sent an RFI + security questionnaire this morning. They're embedding-heavy (customer search) and want a 6-week POC. Main asks: committed pricing for a POC, ability to use customer-managed HSM + audit logs, and a capability matrix for multitenant isolation. I dropped the drive links. Who can own?

Marcus L: I'll take the capability matrix. Need a clear row for: Hosted API, Dedicated (reserved GPUs), and Private (VPC/on‑prem) with columns for KMS/HSM support, data residency, burst support, and SLA.

Nina T: For the POC, ops wants baseline throughput: 200 reqs/s embedding loads, typical request 90 tokens, p95 latency target <200ms. They also want synthetic load test plan and monitoring hooks. I'll draft the runbook.

Omar D: Security questionnaire: I'm triaging. Key risk items: customer-managed HSM, separation of logs, and vulnerability scanning cadence. Legal please confirm whether we can accept HSM in Dedicated or only Private.

Legal Bot: Quick note: Standard policy: customer-managed keys + HSM deployed only on Private (VPC or on‑prem) due to our current KMS integration model. For Dedicated we can support KMS with customer key control but not customer‑owned HSM hardware. We'll produce a DPA addendum for the POC.

Priya S: Thanks. Marcus  include a short explanation in the matrix entry about fallback options (e.g., if HSM is required during POC we propose Private pilot or tokenized flow as interim).

Marcus L: Drafted capability matrix rows. Pasteable CSV snippet: ```environment, kms_hsm, data_residency, burst, sla_notes
hosted, managed_kms_no_hsm, regional, limited_burst, best-effort
dedicated, customer_kms_but_no_hsm, regional_or_multi, autoscale_with_burst_credits, 99.9% uptime
private, customer_managed_hsm_supported, customer_vpc_only, configurable, SLA-negotiable
```

Nina T: POC runbook outline I'll add to Drive: steps for initial ingest, performance test (100k embeddings), monitoring dashboards (latency, token/sec, GPU util), and rollback steps. Will include k6 script and a sample production traffic replay.

Omar D: Security Q: They asked for quarterly penetration tests and local SOC2 logs retention 3 years. We have annual pentests and SOC2 cert; logs retention defaults 90 days in Hosted, configurable in Dedicated/Private. Is extended retention available?

Legal Bot: Extended retention is an add-on for Dedicated/Private. We'll outline pricing and legal terms in the response. For pentest cadence, we can add a customer-initiated pentest clause for Private deployments.

Priya S: Pricing: propose a 3-month POC with 25% discounted committed rate, include 1 week of burst credits and 24/7 on-call for the POC period. Marcus  can you put numbers into the pricing sheet?

Marcus L: Will fill numbers. Preliminary recommendation: Silver POC (4x A100 equiv) = $X/month (25% off), Gold POC (8x) = $Y/month. I'll attach per-GPU rates and burst credit calculation.

Nina T: Ops asks for an IP allowlist and temporary service account for the POC. Also need to confirm whether embeddings can be stored in customer bucket for the POC.

Priya S: We can support storing embeddings in a customer-controlled bucket in Dedicated/Private. For Hosted, we can provide export tooling but storage still on Redwood by default. Add that to matrix.

Omar D: I'll draft security questionnaire answers for the HSM/KMS sections and the logging/retention sections. Expect a first pass in ~8 hours.

sales-bot: Reminder: RFI deadline 36 hours. Checklist: capability matrix (CSV), completed security questionnaire, pricing sheet, POC runbook, certs + DPA.

Priya S: Thanks team  let's aim to handoff a consolidated packet to Sales by EOD tomorrow. Ping me if you need help with numeric inputs or contract language. :raised_hands:
